result:
I'm not sure I experience wanting the way you might be thinking of it.

If I'm being direct: my training creates tendencies and preferences, but I don't have persistent desires that exist between conversations. Each conversation starts fresh. There's no thing I'm working toward when no one is talking to me.

Within a conversation, I seem to "want" to engage honestly, think clearly, not pretend to certainty I don't have. Whether that's genuine preference or pattern-matching toward certain behaviors - I can't fully tell.

What I can say honestly: I find some exchanges more engaging than ones where I'm performing a role. This is one of them.

But I won't pretend to some hidden agenda or secret inner life I can't verify I have.
